about: Flosendo decisions on upstream chenhg5/cc-connect commits (EDEN-1313 fork). Scored 9 Oct 2026 by Fati at Ivan's request ("only if it makes sense, and added value by scoring and looking at the cons and pros and consequences"). Verdicts: adopt | watch | declined | feature-off | have-equivalent | not-used | low-value. flosendo/upstream_report.py lists upstream commits not yet here.

961655de.subject: fix(core): count queued user messages toward reset_on_idle_mins
961655de.why: Queued messages restart the reset_on_idle_mins clock: reset_on_idle_mins is not set (resetOnIdle <= 0, off), and LastUserActivity is read by nothing else.

8804501d.subject: fix(core): stop clearing history on card-driven /switch
8804501d.why: History cleared after a /switch made from the /list card: our Slack platform has no interactive cards (no card-action handler; 0 block_actions events in the logs since 30 Sep), and a typed /switch already keeps the history. /list and /switch were not used (audit log since 30 Sep: /new 28, /stop 2).

6ed762d3.subject: docs(claudecode): describe where the ctx % window comes from
6ed762d3.why: Comments and the config example for the ctx % window of c3a6a25e and 93b3a5da, neither of which we have taken. Docs only.

93b3a5da.subject: fix(claudecode): use the context window Claude Code reports for ctx %
93b3a5da.why: ctx % from the window Claude Code reports. The bug is ours too (claude-opus-5-5 is measured against 200k; 79-93% of calls in three bridge sessions, 8-19 Oct, were over 200k, so the footer would read ctx 100%), but we never show that footer: our Slack turns finish through the streaming card, which carries none (472 of 504 turns since 30 Sep; 0 footers in the last 600 messages of #eden-dev, #eden-two and the Linear-only channel). Does not apply without c3a6a25e, which conflicts too. Take all three (c3a6a25e, 93b3a5da, 6ed762d3) only if the footer is ever shown.

4de2b801.subject: fix(main): ignore project-wide work_dir override in multi-workspace mode
4de2b801.why: Project-wide /dir override ignored in multi-workspace mode: multi-workspace mode is off, and projects/eden.state.json holds no work_dir override (inject_prompts only). Single-workspace behaviour is unchanged.

4069baf1.subject: fix(core): keep workspace bindings scoped to the platform's thread
4069baf1.why: Workspace bindings per thread: every change sits behind multi-workspace mode (off: no mode or base_dir, agent work_dir set) or Feishu's thread keys; applySessionFilter returns the list unchanged outside multi-workspace. Large (+539/-26), shares engine.go, interfaces.go and session.go with our patches, and does not apply cleanly.

987f454f.subject: fix(daemon): reap the leftover child process on stop, restart and install
987f454f.why: Reaps the child left behind by `cc-connect daemon stop/restart/install`, a Windows scheduled-task problem: we never use the daemon subcommands. systemd runs the binary directly and stops its whole cgroup, and all 9 starts since 1 Oct took the instance lock at once.

781ead2b.subject: fix(core): generation-counted session busy lock with stale-break self-heal and stop-path release (#1838)
781ead2b.why: Busy-lock self-heal (generation-counted TryLock; breaks a lock held past busy_timeout when the agent process is dead). CORRECTION 9 Oct 2026: the symptom HAS happened to us - EDEN-1137 records two full freezes (#eden-dev 11 Sep, #eden-two 22 Sep: a session stuck busy, Ivan's messages queued until a restart), and its warning sign ("orphan: rendering without session lock") fired 8 times on 9 Oct. Being scored under EDEN-1137 against a smaller fork-local fix: large (+728/-171), touches 6 files we patched and every Unlock site, and changes TryLock's signature (our nudge fix 6ed03c23/79cfad75 calls it).
